text:
Marta (Marketing Lead): Need a tight benchmark pack for next Wed's launch. Two assets: hero latency-vs-cost chart and a tiny on-page savings calculator. Keep copy about production economics, not model names.
Jason (Growth): CTA must be the microcalc. Suggest subject variants: 'Estimate inference savings in 60s' and 'See your inference spend cut by X%'.
Ben (Product Marketing): I'll write a 1-line methodology note and line labels: X=latency(ms), Y=cost per 1k tokens ($). We'll normalize to our 100ms point.
Anya (Design): I can do a hero + email header. Need CSVs to plot. Prefer compact color scheme (teal/orange/gray).
Leo (Analytics): Uploading two CSVs now: hero_lines.csv and heatmap.csv. Sample rows:
```
# hero_lines.csv
latency_ms,redwood_opt,peer_avg
80,0.045,0.11
150,0.08,0.19
300,0.16,0.35
```
```
# heatmap.csv
prompt_bucket,lever,cost_reduction_pct
0-50,batching,8
51-200,batching,20
201-1000,cache,48
```
Marta: Good. Jason: can you wire the hidden savings-tier field so SDRs get prioritized? Mapping: <15 low, 15-35 mid, >35 high.
Jason (Growth): Yep, will add hidden field and microcalc event.
OpsBot: Reminder set: @Marta check-in tomorrow 10:00am PT.
Marta: Final: keep public claims conservative, link to methodology. Ping here when CSVs/mocks are uploaded.
